diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: N18.2 Chronic kidney disease stage 2
ICD-10: E11.9 Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 57-year-old South Asian male with newly diagnosed hypertension and early CKD stage 2. Presents with BP 155/95, eGFR 70, creatinine 1.35, and mild microalbuminuria (ACR 45 mg/g). ECG shows mild LVH consistent with hypertensive heart disease. Type 2 diabetes remains diet-controlled with HbA1c 6.3%. Family history significant for hypertension and CAD in father. Started on ACE inhibitor therapy.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Return in 4 weeks for BP and electrolyte monitoring after ACE inhibitor initiation. Dietary consultation for low-sodium diet education. Home BP monitoring recommended. Repeat labs in 6 weeks including basic metabolic panel and urinalysis. Consider echocardiogram if BP not controlled. Continue current diabetes management.

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: N18.3 Chronic kidney disease stage 3a
ICD-10: E11.9 Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with newly diagnosed hypertension and early chronic kidney disease. BP elevated at 155/95 despite lifestyle modifications. Laboratory studies show mild reduction in eGFR (70 ml/min) with elevated creatinine (1.35 mg/dL) and microalbuminuria (ACR 45 mg/g). ECG demonstrates mild LVH consistent with hypertensive heart disease. Diabetes remains well-controlled with diet and metformin. Started on ACE inhibitor therapy given hypertension, early CKD, and diabetes. Patient counseled on low-sodium diet and weight management.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Return in 4 weeks to assess BP response to Lisinopril and monitor renal function. Repeat basic metabolic panel and urinalysis in 2-3 weeks. Dietitian consultation scheduled for diabetes and hypertension management. Consider echocardiogram if BP remains elevated. Patient education provided on home BP monitoring and medication compliance.

ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with T2DM and obesity presents for CKD follow-up. Disease has progressed to stage 3b with eGFR decline to 45 and persistent proteinuria. Echo confirms LVH with diastolic dysfunction. BP remains poorly controlled on ACE inhibitor alone. Developed mild anemia consistent with CKD. Hyperkalemia noted at 5.2. Added calcium channel blocker for BP control.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Nephrology referral for CKD management and consideration of phosphate binders. Recheck labs in 2 weeks including CBC, CMP, phosphorus. Dietary consultation for low-potassium diet. Consider iron studies if anemia persists. Blood pressure monitoring at home. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: E11.22 (Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease)
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with progression of CKD to stage 3b. eGFR declined from previous 52 to current 45 mL/min/1.73m². Persistent proteinuria at 380 mg/g creatinine ratio. Echocardiogram confirms development of left ventricular hypertrophy with diastolic dysfunction. Blood pressure remains poorly controlled on current ACE inhibitor therapy. Developing anemia of CKD with hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL. Hyperkalemia noted at 5.2 mEq/L requires monitoring. Diabetes remains well-controlled with diet.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Added Amlodipine 5mg daily for BP control. Nephrology referral initiated for CKD management and anemia evaluation. Monitor potassium levels in 1 week. Dietary counseling for low potassium, low sodium diet. Follow-up in 4 weeks to assess BP response and review nephrology recommendations. Consider iron studies and EPO levels for anemia workup.

ehr_visits.chief_complaint: Follow-up for worsening kidney function, new irregular heartbeat, and shortness of breath with leg swelling

imaging.findings: LVEF 45%, mild LV hypertrophy, mild mitral regurgitation, dilated left atrium. Holter monitor confirms atrial fibrillation with RVR.

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: E11.22 (Type 2 DM with diabetic nephropathy)
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with obesity, T2DM presenting with progression to CKD stage 4 and new-onset atrial fibrillation. Cardiorenal syndrome type 4 diagnosed given chronic kidney disease leading to cardiac complications. Significant fluid overload with elevated BNP. Anemia of CKD present with Hgb 9.8. Blood pressure poorly controlled despite triple therapy. Patient counseled on dialysis access planning and anticoagulation for stroke prevention.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Vascular surgery consult for AV fistula creation within 2 weeks. Cardiology follow-up in 1 week for atrial fibrillation management. Nephrology follow-up in 2 weeks. Consider erythropoiesis-stimulating agent for anemia. Pre-dialysis education referral. Dietitian consultation for CKD/cardiac diet. Home daily weights and strict fluid restriction 1.5L/day. Return if weight gain >2lbs in 24hrs or worsening dyspnea.

imaging.findings: EF 45%, mild left atrial enlargement, grade II diastolic dysfunction, no significant valvular disease. ECG shows atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response

ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with CKD stage 4 (eGFR 25) and newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation. Holter monitor confirmed persistent AFib. Cardiorenal syndrome type 4 diagnosed given chronic CKD with new heart failure symptoms and AFib. Patient shows signs of fluid overload with elevated BNP. Anemia of CKD present with Hgb 9.8. Blood pressure remains elevated despite triple therapy. Discussed need for dialysis access planning given progressive CKD.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Urgent vascular surgery referral for arteriovenous fistula creation. Initiate erythropoiesis-stimulating agent for anemia management. Close monitoring of anticoagulation with renal dosing. Cardiology follow-up in 2 weeks for AFib management. Nephrology follow-up in 4 weeks. Patient education on fluid restriction (2L daily) and low-sodium diet. Pre-dialysis education scheduled. Consider adding chlorthalidone for BP control. Repeat labs in 1 week including CBC, CMP, PT/INR.
